architecture_passed: Architecture verified: the graph is complete and no blocking rule was violated.
architecture_failed: {count, plural, one {# blocking violation} other {# blocking violations}} of the architecture rules.
architecture_incomplete_partial: Architecture not proven: the graph is partial ({unresolved, plural, one {# unresolved dependency} other {# unresolved dependencies}}). A partial graph does not prove the absence of violations.
architecture_incomplete_empty: Architecture not proven: the graph has no node. An empty graph does not prove the absence of violations.
architecture_partial_not_required: Partial graph coverage ({unresolved, plural, one {# unresolved dependency} other {# unresolved dependencies}}); the architecture check is not required in this run.
